title: Warranty Claim Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Automotive Warranty Claim: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Warranty Claim Inspection Checklist covers vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file. The warranty claim coordinator records Automotive Warranty Claim criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Warranty Claim Inspection Checklist keeps Automotive Warranty Claim exceptions visible until the warranty claim coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warranty Claim Inspection Checklist at service facility, diagnostic bay, records system, and retained-parts area. Document vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file identity before Automotive Warranty Claim begins. Compare vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file findings with stated Automotive Warranty Claim criteria; route unresolved Automotive Warranty Claim issues to authorized warranty reviewer. For Warranty Claim Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Automotive Warranty Claim. Ask authorized warranty reviewer to review Automotive Warranty Claim conditions beyond the warranty claim coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Automotive Warranty Claim, identify responsible parties, service facility, diagnostic bay, records system, and retained-parts area, and the linked vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file source.

fields.label: Claim, repair order, customer, and contract
VIN, mileage, in-service date, and coverage reference
Component, part, serial, prior repair, and failure code

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Automotive Warranty Claim facts for vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Automotive Warranty Claim inspection checks
items: Maintenance, modification, misuse, and prior-repair evidence
Repair estimate, part disposition, and authorization
Approval, denial, additional-information, and appeal route

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Automotive Warranty Claim, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Warranty Claim Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Required evidence or retained part missing
blocks.guidance: Pause Automotive Warranty Claim when eligibility, diagnosis, evidence, part retention, repair authority, or coverage decision remains unresolved. Retain the available Automotive Warranty Claim proof and route unresolved vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file scope to warranty claim coordinator.
